explanation: Removed the problematic XML declaration and used a valid layout root to avoid the parse error. Now the two-row button layout remains at bottom, no SAX errors.

activity_edit_flashcard.xml.content:
<LinearLayout
    xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:orientation="vertical"
    android:padding="16dp">

    <!-- Scrollable area for EditTexts -->
    <ScrollView
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:layout_weight="1">

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:orientation="vertical">

            <!-- Question -->
            <EditText
                android:id="@+id/et_question"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:hint="Question"/>

            <!-- Answer -->
            <EditText
                android:id="@+id/et_answer"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:hint="Answer"/>

            <!-- SearchTerm -->
            <EditText
                android:id="@+id/et_search_term"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:hint="Search Term"/>

            <!-- UserNote -->
            <EditText
                android:id="@+id/et_user_note"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:hint="User Note"/>

            <!-- Topics -->
            <EditText
                android:id="@+id/et_topics"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:hint="Topics (comma separated)"/>
        </LinearLayout>
    </ScrollView>

    <!-- Bottom container for two rows of buttons -->
    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:orientation="vertical">

        <!-- First row: Context & Related Question -->
        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:orientation="horizontal"
            android:gravity="end">

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/btn_context"
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="Context"/>

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/btn_generate_related_question"
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="Related Q"/>
        </LinearLayout>

        <!-- Second row: Update, Delete, Copy -->
        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:orientation="horizontal"
            android:gravity="end">

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/btn_update"
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="Update"/>

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/btn_delete"
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="Delete"/>

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/btn_copy"
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="Copy"/>
        </LinearLayout>
    </LinearLayout>

</LinearLayout>
